verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a security-key product with management tooling such as CLI and fleet APIs, so the axis applies. However, no evidence documents a native bulk or multi-item operation. ykman is described as scriptable per-device management, which is a building block for user-side scripting. The YubiEnterprise REST API covers fleet delivery, inventory and shipments, but nothing shows bulk actions across many keys or accounts. Community users describe manually going through each account one by one.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
